name: AI Pulse
author: Fernando Silva da Luz
description: Current AI model leader and curation health from the local AI Pulse server.

barWidget.description: Leader of the AI Pulse leaderboard; turns urgent when the server is down or curation is degraded. Left = dashboard, right = settings, middle = refresh.

schema.label: Server port
schema.description: The AI Pulse background service port (Settings → Startup & service).

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Rankings only change when a poll lands; a minute is plenty.

schema.label: Show leader name
schema.description: Turn off for an icon-only reading that just tracks health.

schema.label: Max name length
schema.description: Longer model names are ellipsized on the bar; the tooltip has the full name.
